criteria.description: A push to `develop` builds the buildable set and publishes every publishable package to npm.pkg.github.com
criteria.evidence: release-rc.yml delegates to publish-packages.yml, which resolves the set via release-graph.mjs --dirs and publishes each. criteria.description: The rc publish never writes dist-tag `latest`
criteria.evidence: The refusal is no longer a set of regexes over workflow YAML — four review passes defeated that, most sharply by reassigning TAG=latest after the input-derived line while satisfying every rule. It now lives in scripts/publish-derived-set.mjs: `latest` requires GITHUB_REF_TYPE=tag AND GITHUB_REF starting refs/tags/, the decision is branded with a module-private Symbol that the executor demands, and 7 EFFECT probes spawn the script against a stub npm and count invocations — those cannot be satisfied by a bypassed main(), which is how the previous version failed. The workflow side asserts the step runs the script bare, forwards env.DIST_TAG from inputs.dist-tag, and that nothing else publishes or runs `npm dist-tag add`.

criteria.description: release.yml publishes to GitHub Packages with credentials that exist, and claims no provenance it cannot produce
criteria.evidence: Operator decision 2026-09-13. registry-url -> npm.pkg.github.com; packages: write added (absent before, so prod would have 403'd); NODE_AUTH_TOKEN -> GITHUB_TOKEN (no NPM_TOKEN secret has ever existed, verified via gh secret list with a control); --provenance and id-token: write removed as unsupported on this registry. checkRegistryAuthorityAgrees now reads setup-node registry-url from every inline publisher, so a reintroduced mismatch reds at PR time. negative_invariants.invariant: The rc stream never writes dist-tag `latest`
negative_invariants.why: The first publish of a package with no existing versions would claim the prod channel, and that cannot be undone.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: scripts/publish-derived-set.mjs (branded decision + two agreeing ref signals, 27 decision probes + 7 effect probes); check-release-graph.mjs asserts the payload's sole route and refuses `npm dist-tag add`

negative_invariants.invariant: A failed publish halts the loop rather than continuing
negative_invariants.why: The set publishes in topological order; continuing past a failure ships dependents against a peer version that does not exist, permanently.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: scripts/publish-derived-set.mjs publishAll() — halts on a real failure rather than accumulating; the loop moved out of the workflow when the publish became a script

negative_invariants.invariant: The payload never declares a permission above what its caller grants
negative_invariants.why: A called workflow declaring above the caller's ceiling fails workflow validation and the run never starts.

negative_invariants.invariant: No gate reports green over an empty set
negative_invariants.why: Standing repo rule; a green line over zero inputs is a defect.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: non-empty assertions in the resolve/audit/publish steps, plus a positive floor on delegating callers
